summary.text: Brian Lampton is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 70 who is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. An insurance agency owner, he chairs the House Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lampton lives in Beavercreek, Ohio, and earned a bachelor’s degree in communications from the University of Dayton in 1987.

His career experience includes owning and operating Lampton/Engle & Associates Insurance, and he served as vice president of the Beavercreek 9/11 Memorial Committee and as president of the Beavercreek and Fairborn Chambers of Commerce.
Lampton has served in the Ohio House since 2021, after winning the 2020 general election for District 73 over Kim McCarthy.
He later won re-election in District 70 in 2022 and 2024, and defeated Terry Free in the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
In the 2025–2026 session he chairs the House Insurance Committee and serves on the Medicaid, Small Business, and Veterans and Military Development committees.
